translated_title: Shortages and Legitimate Demands in Mexico's Public Health Services Will Be Addressed, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Carencias y demandas legítimas en el IMSS serán atendidas: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: After health workers marched over pay and shortages, the President ordered a diagnosis of missing medicines and pledged job security for pandemic-hired doctors.
